articles.title: A mysterious U.S. army barrel washed ashore in Quebec. Why did it drum up anthrax concerns?
articles.description: Quebec provincial police have confirmed that a barrel discovered on an uninhabited island in the St-Lawrence River does not contain active anthrax — ruling out the most dangerous possibility in an ongoing mystery.

articles.title: White House Finalizes The Most Important Policy To Prevent AI Apocalypse You’ve Never Heard Of
articles.description: The White House moved to reduce the likelihood of an artificial intelligence-made bioweapon by vetting the vendors of molecular materials.
